C0333.title: Guixi Court Convicts Individual for Registering Company to Facilitate Cybercrime
C0333.summary: In December 2023, Huang, knowing that others were using information networks to commit crimes, still applied for a company business license, opened a corporate bank account, and lent it out as instructed. The account received 6.36815 million yuan in one-way inflows and transferred out 218,067 yuan in telecom-fraud victim funds. The Guixi Municipal People's Court sentenced Huang to seven months in prison and fined him 10,000 yuan for aiding information network criminal activities; the judgment has taken effect.
